name: Mounted Reaver cuts Mounted Combat abilities' cooldown by 20% (#1001)
contract: Mounted Reaver 707835 reads 'Reduces the cooldown of all Mounted Combat abilities by $s1%.' Its sole effect is native aura 108 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER), MiscValue 11 (SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN), EffectBasePoints -21 with DieSides 1 -- CalcBaseValue subtracts one when DieSides is nonzero (ascension-spell-parity.md), so the resolved amount is -20, not the raw -21 BasePoints. The installed client's own moa_description confirms 'Reduces the cooldown ... by -20%', so -20 is the tooltip-matching value under test, not -21. Effect classmask [0, 8196, 0] (spell_family_id 23) matches two distinct 'Mounted Combat' spells' own family flags in the same capture: Dreadrider's Stomp 804702 (word1 bit2 = 4) and Hellfire Trample 804704 (word1 bit13 = 8192) -- both confirmed via csv.DictReader against /home/fab/CoaServer/reference/snapshots/ascension-data/tables/spell.csv.gz. Player::ApplySpellMod (Player.cpp:10219) is the native SPELLMOD_COOLDOWN consumer: for SPELLMOD_PCT it accumulates totalmul += CalculatePct(1.0f, mod->value) and returns basevalue*totalmul, so a 20000ms base becomes 16000ms. The harness's 'spell_modifier' metric (CoAGameplayTest.cpp) calls this exact native ApplySpellMod path directly, avoiding the need to actually be mounted to exercise it.
